					<h1>About Us</h1>

					
					
					<p>JobWebKenya.com is a leading recruitment portal in Kenya with job and scholarship listing . At JobWebKenya,</p>
<p>we also provide top notch CV and cover letter writing tips for graduates.</p>
<p>For employers, JobWebKenya serves as a powerful recruitment taleo to get the right candidates for a job.</p>
<p>Our services include online job advertisement, a detailed database for freshly uploaded graduate CV , recruitment services and cover letter and CV writing training skills. Our clients range from local SME’s to world class resourced companies.</p>
<p>For job seekers, JobWebKenya.com provide an open access to job application and great resources for career advancement and job placement. Our Vision : Our vision is to be one of Africa’s top job portals with global influence.</p>
<p>Our Mission : To be the first choice job portal, helping job seekers find their dream jobs.</p>
<p>Best Regards</p>
